entities.summary: VNU-HCM An Giang University is a Vietnamese public university based in the city of Long Xuyen in An Giang Province. With over 10,000 enrolled students annually, it is one of the major educational and research institutions in the Mekong Delta region of Vietnam. An Giang University is a university in Asia, established in 1999. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
